title: Kissinger's Harvard career as cover for advising MJ12 through PI40

tellings.quote: Harvard career was merely a cover for deeper intelligence work advising MJ12 through a specialized think tank known as PI40.

plain: The idea is that Henry Kissinger's career as a Harvard academic in the 1950s was only a cover. Behind it, the claim goes, he did intelligence work advising MJ12, a supposed secret group said to oversee UFO matters, through a special think tank called PI40. Michels raises it himself, without naming a source, in an episode asking whether Kissinger ran a program to recover crashed UFOs.
